subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT caused by global warming?

options.text: Melting of glaciers and ice sheets

solution:
The correct answer is** ****__Proper Rainfall__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Global warming**

 
 
• The phenomenon of a **slow rise in temperature** close to the earth's surface is known as **global warming**.
 
• It was largely linked to the **greenhouse effect **brought on by rising **carbon dioxide, CFC, and other pollution** levels.
 
• **Carbon dioxide (CO2); Water vapour (H2O), methane (CH4), nitrous oxide (N2O), and ozone (O3)** are the main greenhouse gases in the atmosphere of the Earth.
 
• **Causes** of global warming:
 
 
• **Erratic weather pattern, **the weather pattern doesn't proceed in a predictable manner; instead, it occurs at unexpected moments or does so irregularly due to increase temperature.
 
• **Melting of glaciers and ice sheets, **rapid snowmelt, and severe droughts will result in greater water shortages and a higher danger of wildfires in the American West. 
 
• **Sea level rise, **coastal flooding will result from rising sea levels along the Eastern Seaboard, particularly in Florida and adjacent regions like the Gulf of Mexico.
 
• Global warming can also be caused by an** imbalance in the ecosystem** brought on by the destruction of forests.
 
 
 
• It is not caused by** proper rainfall**, because proper rainfall occurs when the** temperature is normal**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Effects of Global Warming**:

 
 
• The** temperature **of the world has risen by 1 degrees since **1880**.
 
• Since **glaciers are melting **more frequently as a result of this, the sea level is rising.
 
 
• The consequences for coastal regions will be devastating.
 
 
 
• It has **impacted the coral reefs**, which may result in the extinction of plants and animals.
 
• Several **plants and animals lose their habitats** due to a change in the temperature on a worldwide scale.
 
 
• In this scenario, the creatures must leave their native habitat, and many of them even go extinct.
 
 
 
 
 
• The **following elements** cause global warming: **Carbon dioxide, Methane, Hydro Fluorocarbon (HFCs), and Nitrous Oxide**.
